reviews.text: This vet came highly recommend.  Buy several people.

Been in the place with all of our 3 retired greyhounds many times. I have been in 4 different vets but always coming back to see Brian.

He knows exactly what and how to deal with greyhounds and it may seem to look less gentle than your normal vet but rest assured that they are the specialist.

Had corns removed, nails clipped, X rays done, cancer diagnosis, glass/rocks removed from paws all in one place.
Fantastic. The staff are very friendly and Brian the vet is a gentleman to deal with
An extremely kind and knowledgeable vet. Brian is simply the best there is. He is affordable and most importantly he understands my pets!
Excellent veterinary service provided by Brian and his team.
Brian is absolutely fantastic with my nutty really,  really anxious lurcher cross.  His advice and wisdom is second to none.  All staff that I have dealt with are fantastic.

This is the best VET in Dublin...
Very friendly. Great advice.
Brian is just a Great vet, I could go but there's no need too, Thanks Brian as always 👍 …

Brian is a great vet. He has a very practical approach and is very experienced.  He is also very reasonably priced for excellent service. He has a great understanding of greyhounds and lurchers so people travel from all over the country to him. I feel lucky to have him as a vet to my two lurchers and I highly recommend him to other lurcher owners.
